html:
The Principality of Serbia was the self governing Serbian state that grew out of the Second Serbian Uprising of 1815, led by Miloš Obrenović, and lasted until it became a kingdom in 1882.

Miloš, a cunning leader who had Karađorđe of the First Uprising murdered, won autonomy from the Ottomans by force and bribery; the sultan recognised him as hereditary prince in 1830. Kragujevac, then Belgrade, served as capitals. The state built schools, adopted the reformed language and a constitution, while the Obrenović and Karađorđević houses fought over the throne. The last Ottoman troops left in 1867, and the Congress of Berlin recognised full independence in 1878.
sum: The Principality of Serbia was the self governing Serbian state that grew out of the Second Serbian Uprising of 1815, led by Miloš Obrenović, and lasted until it became a kingdom in 1882.
